title: pip cache disabled
description: pip.conf declares a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact.
limitation: It matches a `no-cache-dir` setting that re-downloads every artifact in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
